reason: Selective Rollout stops converged multi-sample agent trajectories during GRPO training; its Qwen2.5-7B/ALFWorld run reports 10.7% lower training wall-clock and a directional +2.5 pp held-out shift, but transfer and significance are limited (four seeds, one model/environment). title: Selective Rollout: Mid-Trajectory Termination for Multi-Sample Agent RL
